paragraphs: He is mentioned at the end of Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin, chapter 5, speaking in Rav Yehudah’s name.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied notice fully writes Rav Yehudah (רב יהודה), retained in the translation. The Guggenheimer digital text at the end of Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin chapter 5 instead writes Rabbi Yehudah (רבי יהודה).

The saved Guggenheimer Eruvin5 scalar gives full Rabbi Inyaya bar Pazi reporting full Rabbi Yehudah. The supplied heading abbreviates R' Inya and spells איניא, beside the digital אינייא; the heading remains R' without identifying the forms. Hyman’s body fully writes Rav Yehudah, retained beside the digital Rabbi Yehudah. The report direction and end of chapter5 are preserved; no extra chain, law or identity is imported.
